loading-panel-dataset-picker.name: panel-session-dataset-picker
loading-panel-dataset-picker.describes: The Session panel showing the Dataset box for the loaded Pancreatic endocrinogenesis sample above the Sample dataset dropdown, with the pointer on the dropdown.

orientation-welcome-first-run.name: window-welcome-first-run
orientation-welcome-first-run.describes: The Cellucid welcome overlay as it appears on first load, over the sample dataset behind it.

orientation-window-overview.name: window-pancreas-overview
orientation-window-overview.describes: The Cellucid web app with the Pancreatic endocrinogenesis sample loaded in its 3D Orbit view, coloured by the clusters field, with the sidebar and legend visible.

coloring-panel-categorical-field.name: panel-coloring-categorical
coloring-panel-categorical-field.describes: The Coloring and Filtering panel with the clusters field selected as the categorical colouring source.

coloring-window-annotated-field-selector.name: window-annotated-color-by
coloring-window-annotated-field-selector.describes: The Cellucid web app with the categorical field selector ringed and the pointer pressing it, showing where the colouring field is chosen.

legend-region-categories.name: region-legend-categories
legend-region-categories.describes: The legend listing every category of the selected clusters field beside the reported visible-point count.

benchmark-panel-controls.name: benchmark-panel-controls
benchmark-panel-controls.describes: The Benchmark panel before any run: Synthetic data with six presets from 500K to 40M, Point count, Pattern and Embeddings, the Load synthetic data button, and Diagnostics with Analyze performance and Copy situation report; the live performance readout is omitted.

filtering-panel-unfiltered.name: panel-clusters-unfiltered
filtering-panel-unfiltered.describes: The Coloring & filtering panel with the clusters field selected: Color by with its three field selectors, Show cell info, the Legend group with Show centroids, Show labels and the Outlier filter at 100 percent, the Show all and Hide all buttons above the eight-category legend, and Filters reading Showing all 3,696 cells above No filters active.

filtering-active-filters-three-rows.name: active-filters-three-rows
filtering-active-filters-three-rows.describes: The Filters block holding three rows of different kinds at once: an S_score range row ending in its cell count, cut off with an ellipsis, a clusters hiding row, and a clusters: outlier ≤ 95% row with no count.

filtering-window-outlier-95.name: window-outlier-95-applied
filtering-window-outlier-95.describes: The same window with the Outlier filter at 95 percent: fewer scattered cells between the clusters, every legend count reduced, and a clusters: outlier ≤ 95% row in the Filters block above Showing 3,506 of 3,696 cells.

filtering-type-numeric-range.name: type-numeric-range
filtering-type-numeric-range.describes: The Visible range block of the continuous S_score legend with Live filtering switched off: Minimum and Maximum sliders with their values, and the Filter button beside Reset enabled, with the pointer on Filter.

filtering-legend-category-unavailable.name: legend-category-unavailable
filtering-legend-category-unavailable.describes: The clusters legend under a narrow S_score range filter: Alpha, Ductal, Ngn3 high EP and Ngn3 low EP stay ticked with small counts, while Beta, Delta, Epsilon and Pre-endocrine are greyed out with disabled checkboxes and read 0 cells.

filtering-window-gene-range-active.name: window-gene-range-active
filtering-window-gene-range-active.describes: The whole window coloured by the gene Ins1 with the Minimum slider raised, so only the cells expressing it are drawn and an Ins1 range row is listed in the Filters block.

filtering-window-zero-visible.name: window-zero-visible-cells
filtering-window-zero-visible.describes: The whole window with a completely empty canvas after pressing Hide all in the clusters legend: every row unchecked and reading 0 of its count, and the Filters block reading Showing 0 of 3,696 cells above one clusters hiding row.

annotation-lifecycle-01-disconnected.name: lifecycle-01-disconnected
annotation-lifecycle-01-disconnected.describes: The Community annotation panel before any repository is connected: Repository with its (i), the line Not connected. and a Connect repo button, with the pointer on that button.

annotation-lifecycle-02-signin.name: lifecycle-02-signin
annotation-lifecycle-02-signin.describes: Step 1 of 4 of the GitHub sync wizard: a header showing the dataset with GitHub and Repo both not connected, the four steps Sign in, Install app, Choose repository and Sync with Sign in current, the line "Cellucid gets no repository access until you install its GitHub App on repositories you choose.", and a Continue with GitHub button.

annotation-lifecycle-03-install-app.name: lifecycle-03-install-app
annotation-lifecycle-03-install-app.describes: Step 2 of 4 of the GitHub sync wizard, Install app: the header shows the dataset, the signed-in GitHub account and Repo not connected; the line "Add repo opens GitHub to choose repositories; then Reload.", Add repo (under the pointer) and Reload, three repository cards marked Public or Private, and "Showing 1–3 of 3 repositories. Page 1 of 1."

annotation-lifecycle-05-sync.name: lifecycle-05-sync
annotation-lifecycle-05-sync.describes: Step 4 of 4 of the GitHub sync wizard, Sync: the dataset, GitHub account and repository in the header, the line "Pull fetches the latest votes; Publish writes them for everyone.", Pull latest and Publish, an Auto pull checkbox with its interval, and the status line "Pulled latest annotations."

annotation-lifecycle-06-connected-status.name: lifecycle-06-connected-status
annotation-lifecycle-06-connected-status.describes: The connected Community annotation panel: GitHub sync with the Dataset, GitHub and Repo rows and a GitHub sync… button, a Profile block naming the signed-in user with Edit and Clear, and the collapsed Annotated columns, Consensus column and Snapshot and cache groups.

annotation-state-no-repository-matches-f.name: state-no-repository-matches-filter
annotation-state-no-repository-matches-f.describes: Step 3 of 4 of the GitHub sync wizard, Choose repository, with a filter typed that matches no repository and the line No repositories match this filter. under it.

annotation-lifecycle-08-votable-badge.name: lifecycle-08-votable-badge
annotation-lifecycle-08-votable-badge.describes: The Categorical obs select holding clusters, prefixed by a ballot-box badge marking it open for voting, and the legend beneath it: each category with its consensus label (Beta cell under Beta) and its up and down vote counts.

annotation-lifecycle-07-manage-annotatio.name: lifecycle-07-manage-annotation
annotation-lifecycle-07-manage-annotatio.describes: Annotated columns open in the Community annotation panel: the Categorical obs picker on the voting column clusters with Add, Remove and Close, and its consensus settings with a Threshold slider and a Min annotators field.

filtering-active-filters-empty.name: active-filters-empty
filtering-active-filters-empty.describes: The Filters block with its (i), reading Showing all 3,696 cells above the words No filters active.

filtering-scope-tooltip.name: active-filters-scope-tooltip
filtering-scope-tooltip.describes: The (i) of the Filters block pressed, and the information box it opens: every filter hiding cells in the selected view, from the legend, the range sliders and the outlier filter, that unticking one pauses it and removing it drops it, that filters belong to the view they were set in, and Learn more links.

filtering-window-all-visible.name: window-clusters-all-visible
filtering-window-all-visible.describes: The whole application window with the Pancreas embedding coloured by clusters, every legend row checked, and the Filters block reading Showing all 3,696 cells above No filters active.

filtering-window-categories-hidden.name: window-clusters-three-hidden
filtering-window-categories-hidden.describes: The same window after unchecking Ductal, Ngn3 high EP and Ngn3 low EP: those points are absent from the canvas, their legend rows are unchecked and read 0 of their cell counts, and the Filters block reads Showing 1,876 of 3,696 cells above one clusters row.

filtering-active-filters-one-row.name: active-filters-one-row
filtering-active-filters-one-row.describes: The Filters block reading Showing 1,876 of 3,696 cells above one row: a ticked checkbox, the text clusters: hiding Ductal, cut off with an ellipsis, and a remove cross at its right.

filtering-type-category-visibility.name: type-category-visibility
filtering-type-category-visibility.describes: The categorical legend for clusters: Show all and Hide all above eight rows, three of them (Ductal, Ngn3 high EP, Ngn3 low EP) unchecked and reading 0 of their cell counts, each row carrying a colour swatch, a label, a cell count, a rename pencil and a delete bin.

filtering-button-disabled-live-on.name: filter-button-disabled-live-on
filtering-button-disabled-live-on.describes: The same Visible range block with Live filtering on: the Filter button is greyed out under the pointer, beside an enabled Reset button.

filtering-window-continuous-range.name: window-continuous-range-applied
filtering-window-continuous-range.describes: The whole window coloured by S_score with the Minimum slider raised: only the higher-scoring cells are drawn, and the Filters block reads a reduced count above one S_score range row.

filtering-outlier-slider-95.name: outlier-slider-95
filtering-outlier-slider-95.describes: The Outlier filter with its (i), its slider moved left of the end stop and its readout showing 95 percent, with the pointer on the slider.

filtering-window-outlier-100.name: window-outlier-100-off
filtering-window-outlier-100.describes: The whole window coloured by clusters with the Outlier filter at its default 100 percent: scattered cells sit between and around the clusters, and the Filters block reads Showing all 3,696 cells.

filtering-active-filters-row-disabled.name: active-filters-row-disabled
filtering-active-filters-row-disabled.describes: The same three-row Filters list with the clusters hiding row unchecked under the pointer: that row is greyed and struck through while the other two stay black, and the count line above has risen.

filtering-active-filters-remove.name: active-filters-remove-button
filtering-active-filters-remove.describes: A one-row Filters list with the pointer resting on the remove cross at the right edge of the row.

filtering-window-gene-range-scope-lost.name: window-gene-range-scope-lost
filtering-window-gene-range-scope-lost.describes: The same window after switching the active field to clusters: every cell is drawn again, the Ins1 row has left the Filters block, and the count line reads Showing all 3,696 cells.

fields-selector-rows.name: field-selectors-three-routes
fields-selector-rows.describes: The Color by heading with its (i), above the three field selectors stacked in order — Categorical obs holding clusters, Continuous obs holding None, and an empty Gene expression search box — each followed by four small icon buttons, with the pointer pressing the first.

fields-legend-categorical.name: legend-categorical-clusters
fields-legend-categorical.describes: The categorical legend for clusters: the Show all and Hide all buttons above eight rows, each holding a checkbox, a colour swatch, a label, a cell count, a rename pencil and a delete bin.

fields-legend-continuous.name: legend-continuous-sscore
fields-legend-continuous.describes: The continuous legend for S_score: the Color scale (Viridis) bar with its two end values, Log color scale off and Rescale to range on, each with its (i), and below a rule the Visible range block with Live filtering on, Minimum and Maximum sliders, and Filter and Reset.

fields-colormap-menu.name: legend-colormap-menu-open
fields-colormap-menu.describes: The colormap list open under the S_score colour bar: seven named gradients, Viridis, Plasma, Inferno, Magma, Cividis, Turbo and Twilight, with Viridis marked as the active one.

fields-gene-search-open.name: gene-search-dropdown-open
fields-gene-search-open.describes: The Gene expression search box holding the letters Rp with its list open below, naming the genes that contain them.

fields-window-gene-coloring.name: window-color-by-gene-ins1
fields-window-gene-coloring.describes: The whole window coloured by expression of the gene Ins1 on a Viridis scale, dark where the gene is absent and bright in one lobe of the embedding, with the continuous legend in the sidebar.

fields-window-centroids.name: window-centroids-and-labels
fields-window-centroids.describes: The Pancreas embedding coloured by clusters with Show centroids and Show labels both ticked, so each cluster carries a marker at its centre with its category name printed on it.

core-navigation-orbit.name: navigation-controls-orbit
core-navigation-orbit.describes: The Navigation block with Mode set to Orbit and the pointer pressing the select: a Keyboard speed slider, Google Earth-style drag and Show orbit anchor.

core-navigation-planar.name: navigation-controls-planar
core-navigation-planar.describes: The Navigation block with Mode set to Planar: a Keyboard speed slider, Zoom to cursor and Invert axes.

core-navigation-freefly.name: navigation-controls-freefly
core-navigation-freefly.describes: The Navigation block with Mode set to Free-fly: Look sensitivity and Move speed sliders with their readouts, Invert look axes and Projectile shooting, and Capture pointer with its (i).

core-window-dimension-3d.name: window-dimension-3d
core-window-dimension-3d.describes: The whole window showing the Pancreas 3D embedding on the Studio backdrop, with the Navigation Mode select reading Orbit and, under Compare views, the Shows picker reading UMAP · 3D.

core-window-dimension-2d.name: window-dimension-2d
core-window-dimension-2d.describes: The same window after choosing UMAP · 2D in the Shows picker, with the pointer on it: the cells now lie on a plane seen face-on over a dotted backdrop, and the Navigation Mode select has followed the view to Planar.

core-window-dimension-1d.name: window-dimension-1d
core-window-dimension-1d.describes: The same window after choosing UMAP · 1D in the Shows picker: the cells are spread along one axis, and the Navigation Mode select has followed the view to Planar.

core-render-mode-select.name: render-mode-select
core-render-mode-select.describes: The Render mode select reading Points, ringed and with the pointer pressing it, above Shader quality, Point size and the Depth cues sliders (3D lighting, Atmospheric fog, Perspective size scaling).

orientation-window-map.name: window-orientation-map
orientation-window-map.describes: The whole application window with the Pancreas sample loaded, the sidebar showing Coloring & filtering with the embedding coloured by clusters, and the eight-row legend beside the matching colours on the canvas.

fields-gene-search-no-match.name: gene-search-no-match
fields-gene-search-no-match.describes: The Gene expression list after typing a symbol this sample does not publish: No gene matches "CD19", a sentence giving the 3,753 gene names the dataset publishes, and a link Why a gene may be missing.

sessions-refusal-not-a-session-file.name: refusal-02-not-a-session-file
sessions-refusal-not-a-session-file.describes: A Cellucid notification reading "This file is not a Cellucid session file of format 2 (it does not start with CELLUCID_SESSION/2).", with a dismiss button at its right, after a file that is not a session bundle was chosen in Load.

sessions-refusal-different-dataset.name: refusal-01-different-dataset
sessions-refusal-different-dataset.describes: A notification titled "Loading failed" reading "Session file: This session was saved on a different dataset than the one that is open now (3,696 cells and 3,753 genes when it was saved, 219,731 cells and 5,754 genes now). Open the dataset the session was saved on, then load the session again."

sessions-save-restore-01-session-control.name: save-restore-01-session-controls
sessions-save-restore-01-session-control.describes: The Session accordion showing the Dataset box for the loaded sample, the Open data group with the Sample dataset dropdown, the Open… button and the Link or server bar, the Session file group with Save and Load below them, and the collapsed Data mapping group.

sessions-save-restore-02-save-state-acti.name: save-restore-02-save-state-action
sessions-save-restore-02-save-state-acti.describes: The Session file group with its (i), Save and Load side by side, and the pointer on Save.

sessions-renderer-controls-default.name: save-restore-05-renderer-controls-default
sessions-renderer-controls-default.describes: The Cells and Performance controls at their defaults: Shader quality Full (lighting + fog), Point size, the Depth cues sliders, and under Performance Level of detail (LOD) and Frustum culling unchecked and Antialiasing checked.

sessions-renderer-controls-changed.name: save-restore-06-renderer-controls-changed
sessions-renderer-controls-changed.describes: The same controls changed: Shader quality Light, Level of detail (LOD) checked with Force LOD level at 4, and Frustum culling checked.

sessions-renderer-controls-restored.name: save-restore-08-renderer-controls-restored
sessions-renderer-controls-restored.describes: The same controls after a saved session was loaded into a fresh page: Shader quality Light, Level of detail (LOD) checked with Force LOD level 4, and Frustum culling checked, as they were saved.

sessions-official-sample-state-applied.name: official-01-sample-state-applied
sessions-official-sample-state-applied.describes: The whole application window shortly after the Pancreas built-in sample was chosen, showing the embedding coloured by cell type in a 3-D orbit view on the light Studio backdrop, with the Session accordion open beside it.

sessions-save-confirmation.name: save-restore-03-save-confirmation
sessions-save-confirmation.describes: A notification reading "Session saved successfully" after Save produced a session bundle.

sessions-restore-confirmation.name: save-restore-04-restore-confirmation
sessions-restore-confirmation.describes: The one notification a completed restore publishes: the restore's progress entry, now titled "Loaded" and reading "Session fully restored.".

sessions-restored-view.name: save-restore-07-restored-view
sessions-restored-view.describes: The whole application window immediately after a session restore, with the dataset drawn in the viewer and the sidebar showing the restored control values.

accessibility-panel-keyboard-shortcuts.name: keyboard-shortcuts
accessibility-panel-keyboard-shortcuts.describes: The Keyboard shortcuts panel open in the Cellucid sidebar, listing five groups, each with its (i): General (R, F, H, 1 2 3, O P G and ?), Navigation (W A S D and Shift), Zoom (= ] and - [), Free-fly (E Q and Esc) and Selection (Alt+click, Alt+drag, Shift+Alt+click, Ctrl+Alt+click, Esc to cancel a selection, Esc to leave Select mode, and X to clear highlights).

analysis-detailed-categorical-preview.name: detailed-categorical
analysis-detailed-categorical-preview.describes: The Detailed panel with Variable set to Categorical obs then cell_type, a Compare pages block with Page 1 and Rest of Page 1 both selected, a Plot Type select reading Bar Plot under a pointer, and a grouped bar plot of cell-type counts beneath it whose horizontal axis carries two category names, Ductal and Delta, at its two ends.

analysis-de-sidebar-result.name: de-sidebar-result
analysis-de-sidebar-result.describes: The sidebar result of a differential expression run: a small volcano plot with the genes up in Page 1 in red on the right, those down in blue on the left and the rest grey, one of its gene labels shown, and the Expand button below it under the pointer.

analysis-de-volcano-expanded.name: de-volcano-expanded
analysis-de-volcano-expanded.describes: A large modal headed Differential expression: Page 1 vs Rest of Page 1: a volcano plot with seven labelled genes top-left over a legend reading Up (395), Down (698) and Not significant (2660), an Export row of PNG, SVG and CSV buttons above the Plot options on the right, a Summary statistics table bottom-left, and a Statistical analysis table of the top genes bottom-right.

analysis-marker-genes-ranked.name: marker-genes-ranked
analysis-marker-genes-ranked.describes: The Marker genes panel grouped by cell_type, with its Run button, and beneath it the result header, the Show choice (List, Heatmap, Clustered) on Heatmap, and a heatmap of eight cell-type rows against their top marker genes with a Z-score colour bar.

analysis-marker-genes-clustered.name: marker-genes-clustered
analysis-marker-genes-clustered.describes: A heatmap with cell-type groups down one axis and gene names across the other, dendrograms attached to both axes, and a colour bar for the Z-scored expression.

loading-refusal-h5ad-wrong-file.name: fail-h5ad-wrong-file
loading-refusal-h5ad-wrong-file.describes: A Cellucid notification reading "The selected file is not a valid HDF5 file, so it cannot be an AnnData (.h5ad) file. Save it again with anndata…", with a dismiss button at its right.

analysis-detailed-expanded.name: detailed-expanded
analysis-detailed-expanded.describes: The expanded Detailed modal headed COMPARING: CELL_TYPE with a grouped bar plot top-left whose horizontal axis prints five of the eight category names, an Export row and PLOT OPTIONS column on the right, a SUMMARY STATISTICS table bottom-left, and a STATISTICAL ANALYSIS panel bottom-right holding a chi-squared card reading N/A, with a pointer on the CSV button.
analysis-detailed-expanded.cursor: hover on .analysis-export-toolbar button[title="Download data as CSV"]

analysis-autorun-detailed-preview.name: autorun-vs-run-a
analysis-autorun-detailed-preview.describes: The Detailed panel holding a finished result — Variable set to Categorical obs then cell_type, two pages selected, Bar Plot chosen and a grouped bar plot drawn beneath — with no Run button anywhere in the panel.

analysis-marker-genes-expanded.name: marker-genes-expanded
analysis-marker-genes-expanded.describes: The expanded Marker genes view of cell_type with a clustered heatmap and dendrograms in the plot area, an Export row of PNG, SVG and CSV buttons above the plot options, the summary statistics naming the field, method and counts, and the table of top marker genes, with a pointer on the CSV button; the run-time Duration row is omitted.
analysis-marker-genes-expanded.cursor: hover on .analysis-export-toolbar button[title="Download data as CSV"]

analysis-volcano-threshold-permissive.name: volcano-threshold-a
analysis-volcano-threshold-permissive.describes: A volcano plot at a log2 fold-change threshold of 0.5, with broad red and blue clouds of coloured points either side of a narrow grey band, and a legend below the axis title counting each colour.

analysis-volcano-threshold-strict.name: volcano-threshold-b
analysis-volcano-threshold-strict.describes: The same volcano plot at a log2 fold-change threshold of 3, with the threshold lines pushed far apart and almost every point now grey, and a legend below the axis title counting each colour.

annotation-lifecycle-09-pending.name: lifecycle-09-pending
annotation-lifecycle-09-pending.describes: The voting view for the Beta cluster with a banner reading "Pending (1 voter)", one suggestion card (Beta cell, its ontology id, marker and evidence, one upvote), and the New suggestion form below.

annotation-lifecycle-11-consensus.name: lifecycle-11-consensus
annotation-lifecycle-11-consensus.describes: The voting view for the Beta cluster with a banner reading "Consensus: "Beta cell" (100% • 4 voters)", the suggestion card with its ontology id, marker, evidence and four upvotes, and the New suggestion form below.

annotation-lifecycle-12-disputed.name: lifecycle-12-disputed
annotation-lifecycle-12-disputed.describes: The voting view for the Beta cluster with a banner reading "Disputed: "Beta (immature), Beta cell" (0% • 4 voters)", two suggestion cards each at net 0 with two upvotes and two downvotes, and the New suggestion form below.

annotation-lifecycle-10-vote.name: lifecycle-10-vote
annotation-lifecycle-10-vote.describes: One suggestion card showing its label, net score, ontology, marker and evidence lines, its up and down vote buttons, the proposer attribution and the comment box, with the pointer on the upvote button.

annotation-lifecycle-13-new-suggestion.name: lifecycle-13-new-suggestion
annotation-lifecycle-13-new-suggestion.describes: The New suggestion form filled in with a label, an ontology id and marker genes, with Search CAP, Search Ontology and Search Markers buttons beside the fields and Add and Clear buttons below, and the pointer on Add.

annotation-lifecycle-17-publish.name: lifecycle-17-publish
annotation-lifecycle-17-publish.describes: The same Sync step after Publish, its status line reading "Publish complete." under the Pull latest and Publish buttons.

annotation-state-repository-unreadable.name: state-repository-unreadable
annotation-state-repository-unreadable.describes: The whole application window with the Community Annotation panel back in its disconnected state and a notification explaining that the user's role for the repository could not be determined and that the annotation repo was disconnected.

highlighting-across-views.name: share-highlight-across-views
highlighting-across-views.describes: Two 3D panels of the same dataset side by side with the sidebar closed, each under a title chip (1 · UMAP 3D · cell_type, 2 · UMAP 3D · cell_type): the left panel at the default close-up camera, the right panel zoomed out and rotated; the cells confirmed by one lasso drawn in the left panel are drawn in the highlight colour in both.

highlighting-choose-mode.name: choose-highlight-mode
highlighting-choose-mode.describes: The Highlighting panel before anything is selected: the Selection (i) and the four Tool buttons — Annotation (active), KNN drag, Proximity drag and Lasso — ringed, with the pointer on Lasso; the Select mode switch, off; Highlights with one page tab reading Page 1 (0) and the empty list reading No cells highlighted; and the collapsed Create categorical.

highlighting-lasso-draw.name: 01-draw-lasso
highlighting-lasso-draw.describes: The 2D planar Pancreas embedding mid-lasso: Alt is held, the pointer is pressed at the end of a dotted path drawn most of the way round the upper part of the left lobe, and the cells the path already encloses are drawn in the highlight colour while the panel shows no step yet.

highlighting-lasso-step.name: 02-review-lasso-step
highlighting-lasso-step.describes: The Highlighting panel after the lasso was released, showing the step readout "Step 1: 826 cells" with the help line "Alt to intersect, Shift+Alt to add, Ctrl+Alt to subtract", and the ringed Confirm, undo, redo and Cancel step controls with the pointer on Confirm; the page tab still reads Page 1 (0) and the list still reads "No cells highlighted".

highlighting-lasso-confirmed.name: 03-confirm-lasso-group
highlighting-lasso-confirmed.describes: The Highlighting panel after Confirm: the page tab reads Page 1 826, and the ringed group list shows the summary "826 cells highlighted", a Clear button, and one group row labelled "Lasso (826 cells) (826)" with a checkbox and a remove control.

highlighting-lasso-result-window.name: 04-view-highlighted-cells
highlighting-lasso-result-window.describes: The whole window after confirming the lasso group: the 826 enclosed cells in the upper part of the left lobe are drawn in the highlight colour, and the Highlighting panel reports 826 cells highlighted with one Lasso group.

highlighting-annotation-click.name: select-category-by-click
highlighting-annotation-click.describes: Annotation selection after Alt+click on a cell of the green Beta arm: all 591 Beta cells are drawn in the highlight colour, a tooltip by the pointer names Beta, 591 cells and cell_type, and the panel reads Step 1: 591 cells with the help line "Alt to replace, Shift+Alt to add, Ctrl+Alt to subtract" above the Confirm, undo, redo and Cancel controls.

highlighting-proximity-drag.name: drag-proximity-radius
highlighting-proximity-drag.describes: Proximity drag mid-gesture on the 2D embedding: a dashed circle centred on a dot at the seed cell in the left lobe, the cells inside it drawn in the highlight colour, and the pointer pressed on the circle's edge.

highlighting-knn-drag.name: drag-knn-degree
highlighting-knn-drag.describes: KNN drag mid-gesture from the same seed cell, dragged upward by the same distance: a small dashed circle labelled 3° around the seed, and the highlighted cells spreading through the left lobe along the neighbour graph rather than filling a disc, with the pointer pressed above the seed.

highlighting-two-pages.name: compare-highlight-pages
highlighting-two-pages.describes: The Highlighting panel with two page tabs ringed, their names shortened — Page 1 with a blue swatch carrying 826, and the active Page 2 with a red swatch carrying 267, each with a combine (⋈) and a delete (×) control — the list reading 267 cells highlighted with one Proximity (267 cells) (267) group, and the pointer on the button that adds another page.

highlighting-missed-click-notice.name: read-missed-click-notice
highlighting-missed-click-notice.describes: A proximity Alt+click on empty space: the pointer is pressed above the embedding where no cell is drawn, and the ringed line in the Highlighting panel, under the tool buttons, reads "That click did not land on a cell, so there is nothing to select. Zoom in or raise Point size to make cells easier to hit: only the cells the viewer is currently drawing can be clicked."

highlighting-no-active-field-notice.name: read-no-active-field-notice
highlighting-no-active-field-notice.describes: The Highlighting panel with the Annotation tool chosen and no field coloured, and the Selection (i) tip open, its first line ringed: "Color by a field first (Coloring & filtering), then Alt+click a cell."

highlighting-annotation-step.name: read-annotation-step
highlighting-annotation-step.describes: The Highlighting panel after an annotation Alt+click on a Beta cell, with the ringed step readout "Step 1: 591 cells" and the help line "Alt to replace, Shift+Alt to add, Ctrl+Alt to subtract" above Confirm, undo, redo and Cancel.

highlighting-named-page.name: highlighting-selected-page
highlighting-named-page.describes: The Highlighting panel with one page renamed "Left lobe" carrying 826 cells, the summary "826 cells highlighted", and one group row labelled "Lasso (826 cells) (826)".

core-multiview-two-panels.name: multiview-two-panels
core-multiview-two-panels.describes: The whole window in Grid compare with the sidebar open: two equal panels to the right of the sidebar show the Pancreas 3D embedding from the same linked camera — view 1 coloured by cell_type, view 2 recoloured by S_score on a Viridis scale — each under a title chip naming its embedding and field. The sidebar shows Compare views with the two view rows, each marked linked and Orbit, View 2 shows UMAP · 3D, Keep view, Link cameras, Layout Grid compare and Clear, and Coloring & filtering with S_score in the Continuous obs select.

performance-dark-theme-multiview.name: dark-theme-multiview
performance-dark-theme-multiview.describes: The whole window in the dark theme on the Grid (dark) background, in Grid compare with the sidebar open: two equal panels show the Pancreas 3D embedding coloured by cell_type from the same linked camera, each under a title chip. The sidebar shows Visualization with Theme Dark and Background Grid (dark), and Compare views below it with the two view rows.

core-connectivity-multiview.name: connectivity-multiview
core-connectivity-multiview.describes: Two equal panels filling the whole window with the sidebar closed (the ☰ button at the top left), both showing the Pancreas 3D embedding coloured by cell_type from the same linked camera, each under a title chip, and in both the neighbour-graph edges, drawn at line width 2.0, form a grey web between the cells.

core-window-smoke-cloud.name: window-smoke-cloud
core-window-smoke-cloud.describes: The whole window in Volumetric smoke cloud mode: the Pancreas cells drawn as a soft cloud tinted with the colours of their clusters, and the sidebar showing Render mode set to Volumetric smoke cloud (beta) with its Beta tag above the Smoke quality, Smoke shape, Smoke lighting and Performance controls, Animation speed at Still.

loading-open-menu.name: choose-local-data-control
loading-open-menu.describes: Close-up of File or folder: the full-width Open… button with its menu open, showing File… (AnnData, Seurat/SCE .rds/.rda, Loom, 10x .h5, .h5mu) and Folder… (Zarr, 10x outs, MatrixMarket), with the pointer on File….

home-hero-light-1280.name: hero-light-1280
home-hero-light-1280.describes: Cellucid in the light theme on the Studio backdrop: a 3D UMAP of the developing human immune system atlas (Suo), all 561,947 cells coloured by cell type, beside the Coloring and filtering panel, whose legend lists each cell type with its number of cells.

home-hero-light-2400.name: hero-light-2400
home-hero-light-2400.describes: Cellucid in the light theme on the Studio backdrop: a 3D UMAP of the developing human immune system atlas (Suo), all 561,947 cells coloured by cell type, beside the Coloring and filtering panel, whose legend lists each cell type with its number of cells.

home-hero-dark-1280.name: hero-dark-1280
home-hero-dark-1280.describes: Cellucid in the dark theme on the Nebula backdrop: a 3D UMAP of the developing human immune system atlas (Suo), all 561,947 cells coloured by cell type, beside the Coloring and filtering panel, whose legend lists each cell type with its number of cells.

home-hero-dark-2400.name: hero-dark-2400
home-hero-dark-2400.describes: Cellucid in the dark theme on the Nebula backdrop: a 3D UMAP of the developing human immune system atlas (Suo), all 561,947 cells coloured by cell type, beside the Coloring and filtering panel, whose legend lists each cell type with its number of cells.

home-feature-genes-light.name: feature-genes-light
home-feature-genes-light.describes: The Pancreas 2D UMAP in the light theme, coloured by expression of the gene Ttr on a log colour scale (Viridis): brightest in the endocrine cells on the right, a darker gradient along the trajectory, and pale grey for the few cells with none; the colour bar is open in the sidebar.

home-feature-genes-dark.name: feature-genes-dark
home-feature-genes-dark.describes: The Pancreas 2D UMAP in the dark theme, coloured by expression of the gene Ttr on a log colour scale (Viridis): brightest in the endocrine cells on the right, a darker gradient along the trajectory, and pale grey for the few cells with none; the colour bar is open in the sidebar.

home-feature-analysis-light.name: feature-analysis-light
home-feature-analysis-light.describes: The expanded Marker genes window for cell_type in the light theme, over the blurred Pancreas embedding: a heatmap of z-scored expression with the eight cell types down the side and their top marker genes across, Export and Plot options beside it, and below, the summary statistics and a table of the top genes of the selected group.

home-feature-analysis-dark.name: feature-analysis-dark
home-feature-analysis-dark.describes: The expanded Marker genes window for cell_type in the dark theme, over the blurred Pancreas embedding: a heatmap of z-scored expression with the eight cell types down the side and their top marker genes across, Export and Plot options beside it, and below, the summary statistics and a table of the top genes of the selected group.

home-feature-velocity-light.name: feature-velocity-light
home-feature-velocity-light.describes: The Pancreas 2D UMAP in the light theme with the sidebar closed, coloured by cell type, and the RNA velocity overlay on: streaks of particles flowing along the embedding, brightest where the velocity is largest.

home-feature-velocity-dark.name: feature-velocity-dark
home-feature-velocity-dark.describes: The Pancreas 2D UMAP in the dark theme with the sidebar closed, coloured by cell type, and the RNA velocity overlay on: streaks of particles flowing along the embedding, brightest where the velocity is largest.

home-feature-compare-light.name: feature-compare-light
home-feature-compare-light.describes: Two equal panels in the light theme with the sidebar closed, both showing the Pancreas 3D embedding from one linked camera: on the left coloured by cell type, on the right by the S-phase score on a Viridis scale, each under a title chip naming its field.

home-feature-compare-dark.name: feature-compare-dark
home-feature-compare-dark.describes: Two equal panels in the dark theme with the sidebar closed, both showing the Pancreas 3D embedding from one linked camera: on the left coloured by cell type, on the right by the S-phase score on a Viridis scale, each under a title chip naming its field.

analysis-panel-modes.name: analysis-panel-modes
analysis-panel-modes.describes: The Analysis panel with every analysis collapsed, in three groups: Genes (Marker genes, Differential expression, Dot plot, Gene signature), Cells (Composition) and Explore (Quick, Detailed, Correlation); each row carries a chevron, an (i) and a copy-window button.

analysis-de-form-before-run.name: autorun-vs-run-b
analysis-de-form-before-run.describes: The Differential expression form before a run: Compare set to Pages, Group A Page 1 and Group B Rest of Page 1, the Swap A and B link, More options collapsed, and the Run button under the pointer; no result yet.

analysis-rest-of-page-chips.name: rest-of-page-selector
analysis-rest-of-page-chips.describes: The page chips of the Detailed panel: Page 1 with its colour swatch and the count 262, and Rest of Page 1 with its own swatch and count, both selected, with the pointer on Rest of Page 1.

analysis-expand-button.name: expand-button
analysis-expand-button.describes: A Detailed result in the sidebar: the small bar plot of cell_type for the two pages and, under it, the Expand button with the pointer on it.

analysis-floating-window.name: floating-analysis-window
analysis-floating-window.describes: The whole Cellucid window with the Correlation analysis copied into a floating window over the point cloud: its own header with copy, maximise, close and collapse buttons, and its own copy of the Correlation form.

analysis-quick-insights.name: quick-insights
analysis-quick-insights.describes: The Quick panel for Page 1, 262 cells: a Composition section with a bar for clusters_coarse and one for clusters, each a single Ngn3 low EP segment named beneath at 100.0%, a Statistics section with the mean, median and standard deviation of S_score and G2M_score, and the collapsed Page selection.

analysis-quick-no-pages.name: analysis-empty-no-pages
analysis-quick-no-pages.describes: The Quick panel before any cells were confirmed into a page: it reports Page 1 with 0 cells and has no composition or statistics to show.

analysis-correlation-result.name: correlation-results
analysis-correlation-result.describes: The Correlation form with Page 1 and Rest of Page 1 selected, X axis S_score and Y axis G2M_score (Continuous obs), More options open on Display with Colour by cell_type, and the Run button.

analysis-correlation-expanded.name: correlation-expanded
analysis-correlation-expanded.describes: The expanded Correlation view of S_score against G2M_score: the scatter with its per-page trend lines, the options beside it, and the summary and statistics tables with r, r², p and n per page.

analysis-signature-result.name: gene-signature
analysis-signature-result.describes: The Gene signature panel with one gene set holding Ins1, Ins2 and Iapp, both pages selected, and the signature score of each page drawn beneath.

analysis-signature-expanded.name: gene-signature-expanded
analysis-signature-expanded.describes: The expanded Gene signature view of Ins1, Ins2 and Iapp: the score distribution of each page, the options beside it, a summary table per page and the two-group tests with their effect sizes.

analysis-dotplot-result.name: dotplot-result
analysis-dotplot-result.describes: The Dot plot form with Group by clusters and one gene set, Set 1, holding eight pancreatic markers as chips (Krt19, Sox9, Neurog3, Fev, Ins1, Gcg, Sst, Ghrl), the box to add or paste more, Clear, Add set and Import, More options, the Run button, and under it the line the result opens with: 8 genes, 8 groups of clusters and the cell count.

analysis-dotplot-expanded.name: dotplot-expanded
analysis-dotplot-expanded.describes: The expanded Dot plot of the eight pancreatic markers across the eight clusters: one row per cluster, dot colour the mean expression and dot size the fraction of cells expressing it, with its colour bar and size legend, Export, and a summary table below.

analysis-composition-result.name: composition-result
analysis-composition-result.describes: The Composition panel on the Kanemaru heart sample with Cell types LVL1, Samples sample_ID and Condition sex, and the stacked bars beneath: one bar per sample, grouped under its condition, split by cell type.

analysis-composition-expanded.name: composition-expanded
analysis-composition-expanded.describes: The expanded Composition view on the Kanemaru heart sample: the stacked bars per sample by sex, the options beside them, and the table of each cell type's proportions and test result.

analysis-de-running.name: de-running
analysis-de-running.describes: The Differential expression panel while it runs: the Run button disabled, and under it a box naming the comparison (Page 1 against Rest of Page 1, with their cell counts), the step under way with how many genes of how many are done, a progress bar and a Cancel button.

analysis-de-cancelled.name: de-cancelled
analysis-de-cancelled.describes: The Differential expression panel after Cancel: the Run button enabled again, and under it a box saying the run was cancelled, after how long, that nothing was kept, and a Run again button.

analysis-life-01-pending-step.name: life-01-confirm-a-selection
analysis-life-01-pending-step.describes: The Highlighting panel with the Annotation tool chosen and a pending step reading "Step 1: 262 cells" with Confirm, undo, redo and Cancel, above Page 1, which still holds no cells. The pointer is on Confirm.

analysis-life-02-page-ready.name: life-02-two-pages-ready
analysis-life-02-page-ready.describes: The same Highlighting panel after Confirm: Page 1 holds 262 cells, and the list below it reads 262 cells highlighted with Clear, above the confirmed group with its checkbox and remove button.

analysis-de-page-selection.name: de-page-selection
analysis-de-page-selection.describes: The top of the Differential expression form: Compare set to Pages, Group A reading Page 1 and Group B reading Rest of Page 1.

analysis-de-fdr-denominator.name: de-fdr-denominator
analysis-de-fdr-denominator.describes: The statistics table of an expanded differential expression result: Genes tested, Not tested, Significant at the adjusted-p and |log2FC| thresholds, Up in A, Down in A, the p-value convention, Multiple testing (Benjamini–Hochberg), the expression matrix and the fold change.

analysis-export-toolbar.name: export-toolbar
analysis-export-toolbar.describes: The export row of an expanded analysis result: an Export label followed by PNG, SVG and CSV buttons.

loading-best-guess-notification.name: best-guess-notification
loading-best-guess-notification.describes: A Cellucid notification reading "This file has no default UMAP (X_umap_1d, X_umap_2d, X_umap_3d, X_umap, X_UMAP, X_wnn.umap or X_ref.umap). Showing 'X_pca' as 2D. Change it under Session › Data mapping.", with a Show button under the text and a dismiss button at its right.

loading-best-guess-show.name: best-guess-show-checklist
loading-best-guess-show.describes: The Data mapping group after Show on the best-guess notification: Embeddings open and summarised as 1 on · PCA 2D · guessed, its one row, PCA in 2D, on and marked Default and guessed, above the collapsed Genes, Neighbour graph, Latent space and Vector fields groups and the Revert and Apply buttons.

loading-data-mapping-other-arrays.name: data-mapping-other-arrays
loading-data-mapping-other-arrays.describes: The Data mapping group of the Garcia sample with its Embeddings checklist open as one flat list of rows, each with its checkbox, name, dimension and Default mark, and at its end Other arrays (1) open, listing scVI 1,2, which is off, with its width, 24 columns.

filtering-outlier-no-latent.name: outlier-no-latent
filtering-outlier-no-latent.describes: The Outlier filter in the legend for a file without a latent space: the label, its (i) and one Choose latent space button, with no slider, and the pointer on the button.

loading-session-panel.name: data-loading-session-panel
loading-session-panel.describes: The Session panel with the Pancreatic endocrinogenesis sample loaded: the Dataset box with its name, cells and genes, format and host, description and a collapsed Details; Open data with the Sample dataset dropdown, the Open… button and the Link or server bar; Save and Load under Session file; and the collapsed Data mapping group.

loading-session-panel-dark.name: data-loading-session-panel-dark
loading-session-panel-dark.describes: The same Session panel in the dark theme: the Dataset box, Open data with the Sample dataset dropdown, Open… and the Link or server bar, Session file with Save and Load, and the collapsed Data mapping group.

loading-dataset-box-details.name: dataset-box-details
loading-dataset-box-details.describes: The Dataset box after an .h5ad file was opened from a web address: its name, the cells and genes line, "h5ad file" and the host, how much has been read in how many requests, and Details open, listing File, Format, Size, Read, Cells, Genes, Obs fields, Embeddings and the rest.

loading-link-control-typed.name: open-from-link-control
loading-link-control-typed.describes: The Link or server bar with "zenodo:23288289" typed into it, the pointer on its Open button.

loading-link-catalog-connected.name: connect-data-link
loading-link-catalog-connected.describes: The Open data group connected to a dataset catalog folder: the dropdown labelled "Dataset from" the catalog's host and holding its datasets, Open…, and the Link or server bar holding the address, with one line under it reading Link, the address and a compact Disconnect button.

loading-address-server-connected.name: connect-remote-server
loading-address-server-connected.describes: The Link or server bar holding the address of a cellucid serve server on this computer, with one line under it reading Server, the server's address and a compact Disconnect button.

loading-link-refusal-unrecognised.name: fail-data-link-unrecognised
loading-link-refusal-unrecognised.describes: A Cellucid notification reading "Cellucid does not recognise "not a link"", followed by the kinds of link it opens.

loading-open-h5ad-window.name: h5ad-current-loaded
loading-open-h5ad-window.describes: The whole Cellucid window after the Pancreas sample was opened as an .h5ad file with Open… › File…: the Session panel's Dataset box names the file, its cells and genes and "h5ad file · this computer", and the canvas shows its UMAP.

loading-open-zarr-zip-dataset-box.name: zarr-zip-loaded
loading-open-zarr-zip-dataset-box.describes: The Dataset box after a Zarr ZIP archive was opened from this computer: the dataset's name, its cells and genes, "Zarr v2 ZIP · this computer", its description, and Details open with its source and citation, the file, its format and size, how it is read, and what it holds.

loading-open-rds-dataset-box.name: rds-dataset-box
loading-open-rds-dataset-box.describes: The Dataset box after a Seurat object saved with saveRDS() was opened: its cells and genes, "R object (.rds) · this computer", the line "Read whole once (it cannot be read in parts), kept in this browser's storage for next time", and Details open with Read (whole, once, from start to end, nothing uploaded), Kept (the origin-private file system until it is cleared), Read in parts (a Cellucid-ready AnnData) and what it holds.

loading-open-loom-dataset-box.name: loom-dataset-box
loading-open-loom-dataset-box.describes: The Dataset box after a Loom file was opened: the title stored in the file, its cells and genes, "Loom (.loom) · this computer", and Details open with the file, its size, how it is read, and what it holds: four obs fields and a UMAP.

loading-open-matrix-market-dataset-box.name: matrix-market-dataset-box
loading-open-matrix-market-dataset-box.describes: The Dataset box after a MatrixMarket folder with a cell table was opened with Open… › Folder…: the folder's name, its cells and genes, "MatrixMarket folder · this computer", the line saying where the converted data is kept, and Details open.

loading-open-tenx-outs-window.name: tenx-outs-window
loading-open-tenx-outs-window.describes: The whole Cellucid window after a Cell Ranger outs/ folder was opened with Open… › Folder…: the Dataset box reads "10x Cell Ranger outs folder · this computer", and the canvas shows Cell Ranger's UMAP coloured by its clustering, gene_expression_clusters.

loading-open-rda-choose-object.name: rda-choose-object
loading-open-rda-choose-object.describes: The opening panel over the viewer reading "Opening pancreas-objects.rda" and "pancreas-objects.rda holds 2 single-cell objects. Open which one?", with one button per Seurat object, "pancreas (Seurat, 3,696 cells)" and "pancreas_ductal (Seurat, 916 cells)", and Cancel.

loading-h5mu-modality-select.name: data-mapping-modality
loading-h5mu-modality-select.describes: The Data mapping group of a CITE-seq .h5mu with Genes open: a Modality select reading "rna · 28 features" above Expression, Gene names, Values and Highly variable genes, and Revert and Apply below.

loading-opening-progress.name: opening-progress
loading-opening-progress.describes: The opening panel centred over the empty viewer while a linked Seurat .rds is downloaded: "Opening" and the file's address, the step "Downloading the whole file (9.4 MB): … does not serve parts of files", a progress bar part-way, how much has arrived with the speed and time left, the note saying the host serves the file only whole, how much is downloaded and that it is kept, and a Cancel button.

loading-opening-failed.name: opening-failed
loading-opening-failed.describes: The panel over the empty viewer after a linked file could not be opened: "The data could not be opened", one sentence saying why (the file was not found at its host, HTTP 404) and what to do, a folded Details, and the buttons Open without this link, focused, and Try again.

loading-gdrive-private-sign-in.name: gdrive-private-sign-in
loading-gdrive-private-sign-in.describes: The Link or server bar holding a Google Drive file link, with one line under it reading "Private file on Google Drive.", a Sign in to Google button and an (i).

loading-onedrive-sign-in.name: onedrive-sign-in
loading-onedrive-sign-in.describes: The Link or server bar holding a OneDrive share link, with one line under it reading "OneDrive file: sign in with Microsoft to open it.", a Sign in with Microsoft button and an (i).

loading-github-path-typed.name: connect-github-catalog
loading-github-path-typed.describes: The Link or server bar with the GitHub path "theislab/cellucid-demo-custom-datasets/catalog" typed into it and the pointer on its Open button.

loading-link-refusal-github-not-found.name: fail-github-catalog-not-found
loading-link-refusal-github-not-found.describes: A Cellucid notification saying the linked data could not be opened because the GitHub folder holds no datasets.json, after a repository path rather than its catalog folder was opened.

loading-address-refusal-server-unreachab.name: fail-remote-server-unreachable
loading-address-refusal-server-unreachab.describes: A Cellucid notification saying the Cellucid server could not be reached at a loopback address, and what to check.

loading-keep-dataset-after-failure.name: keep-dataset-after-failed-connect
loading-keep-dataset-after-failure.describes: The whole Cellucid window after a server address with nothing behind it was opened: the Pancreas sample is still drawn and still named in the Dataset box, and one error notification sits in the lower right.

server-cellucid-serve-window.name: open-served-dataset
server-cellucid-serve-window.describes: Cellucid opened at the Viewer URL of cellucid serve, coloured by clusters: the Dataset box names the Pancreas sample with its cells and genes, "Zarr v2 folder" and the server's loopback address, and how much was read; the Link or server bar holds that address with one line under it reading Server, the address and Disconnect.

python-viewer-driven-from-python.name: show-anndata-driven-from-python
python-viewer-driven-from-python.describes: The viewer cellucid.show_anndata() serves, opened at its viewer URL, after Python called viewer.set_color_by("clusters") and viewer.highlight_cells() on the Ductal cells: the Pancreas sample coloured by clusters with the Ductal cells highlighted.

r-viewer-driven-from-r.name: cellucid-view-driven-from-r
r-viewer-driven-from-r.describes: Cellucid opened by cellucid_view() on a Seurat object in an R session, after R called cellucid_color_by(viewer, "clusters") and cellucid_highlight() on the Ductal cells: the points are coloured by clusters with the Ductal cells highlighted, and the Dataset box names the object.

orientation-app-overview-cell-type.name: app-overview-cell-type
orientation-app-overview-cell-type.describes: The whole Cellucid window with the Pancreas sample coloured by cell_type: the sidebar shows Coloring and filtering with the categorical field selected and its eight-row legend, and the 3D embedding fills the canvas in the matching colours.

orientation-welcome-startup.name: welcome-startup
orientation-welcome-startup.describes: The Cellucid welcome overlay as a first visit opens it, with Choose a dataset and Learn more, over the Suo atlas loaded behind it.

orientation-startup-loaded-build.name: startup-loaded-build
orientation-startup-loaded-build.describes: The Suo atlas loaded after the welcome overlay is dismissed, with every sidebar section collapsed so the footer shows, ending in the Version and Build line.

core-dimension-navigation-controls-2d.name: dimension-navigation-controls-2d
core-dimension-navigation-controls-2d.describes: The Navigation block reading Planar above the Compare views block whose Shows picker reads UMAP · 2D: choosing a 2D embedding for a view switched its navigation to Planar.

core-connectivity-edges-window.name: connectivity-edges-controls
core-connectivity-edges-window.describes: The whole window with Show connectivity edges on: the neighbour graph drawn as thin lines between the Pancreas cells, and the sidebar showing the Connectivity block with Edge color, Edge opacity, Line width and Max edges.

core-camera-path-unconfigured.name: camera-path-unconfigured
core-camera-path-unconfigured.describes: The Camera path panel with no saved positions: Keyframes with Save position and Clear all, and the Playback settings below.

core-camera-path-configured.name: camera-path-configured-panel
core-camera-path-configured.describes: The Camera path panel after two positions were saved: keyframes KF 1 and KF 2 with the KF 1 → KF 2 duration on auto, End with a return to the first keyframe, Set all with Apply, and Playback with Default speed, Position interpolation Catmull-Rom spline, Rotation interpolation SLERP (smooth), Easing Linear, Loop playback and Autoplay.

core-camera-path-transport.name: camera-path-transport-visible
core-camera-path-transport.describes: The whole window after two camera positions were saved: the playback bar across the top of the canvas with its Play button and timeline markers, and the Camera path panel in the sidebar.

velocity-dataset-without-field.name: read-dataset-without-vector-field
velocity-dataset-without-field.describes: The Connectivity block of the Visualization panel with the Kanemaru heart sample loaded, and no Vector field block under it, because the dataset has none.

velocity-dataset-with-field.name: read-dataset-with-vector-field
velocity-dataset-with-field.describes: The same part of the Visualization panel with the Pancreas sample loaded: the Connectivity block followed by a Vector field block whose Show overlay box is unchecked.

velocity-window-without-overlay.name: 01-embedding-without-overlay
velocity-window-without-overlay.describes: The Pancreas 2D embedding coloured by cell_type, with the Vector field block ringed in the sidebar and its Show overlay box unchecked.

velocity-window-with-overlay.name: 02-embedding-with-overlay
velocity-window-with-overlay.describes: The same 2D embedding with Show overlay checked: bright particle trails stream across the cells, and the Vector field controls are open in the sidebar, ending in the line that names the embeddings the field is available on.

velocity-core-controls.name: set-core-overlay-controls
velocity-core-controls.describes: The Vector field block with Show overlay checked: the Vector field select on velocity, the Particle density, Flow speed, Trail length, Particle size and Opacity sliders with their values, Color scheme, Sync with LOD, and the collapsed Advanced visual settings.

velocity-window-overlay-2d.name: overlay-controls
velocity-window-overlay-2d.describes: The Pancreas sample in 2D with the velocity overlay running over the cells and the Vector field controls open in the sidebar.

velocity-window-overlay-3d.name: pancreas-velocity-3d
velocity-window-overlay-3d.describes: The Pancreas sample in its 3D view coloured by clusters with the velocity overlay running, and the Vector field controls open in the sidebar.

velocity-window-advanced.name: advanced-settings
velocity-window-advanced.describes: The 2D velocity overlay with Advanced visual settings open in the sidebar: Particle rendering, Trail settings, HDR and bloom, Color grading and Cinematic effects.

export-panel-overview.name: panel-overview
export-panel-overview.describes: The Figure export panel with its four collapsed groups, Framing, Labels and annotations, Style and Download, above the Export button, with the pointer on Export.

export-framing.name: framing
export-framing.describes: The Framing group open: Plot size on Screen (half) with its W and H boxes, and Preview with its Show preview checkbox, above the Export button.

export-labels.name: labels-annotations
export-labels.describes: The Labels and annotations group open: the Title box pre-filled, starting with the dataset name; the Annotations checkboxes Axes, Legend, Reference grid, 3D orientation and Depth sort; the X and Y axis labels; Legend: Right; and Emphasize selection.

export-style.name: style
export-style.describes: The Style group open: background, font family and the text sizes for the base text, legend, ticks, axis labels, title and centroid labels.

export-download.name: download
export-download.describes: The Download group open with the format set to SVG: the SVG point strategy select on its placeholder, shortened to "Choose S…", and Export all views (split-view) with the pointer on its checkbox, above the Export button.

export-preview-window.name: preview
export-preview-window.describes: The whole window with Preview on in the Framing group: the sidebar shows the figure as it will be written, beside the live view on the canvas.

export-blocked-dialog.name: read-export-blocked-dialog
export-blocked-dialog.describes: The Export blocked dialog over the app: "Cellucid will not create an export that differs from the active view", Velocity overlay not exported with its reason, and a single Back button.

benchmark-window-synthetic.name: benchmark-panel
benchmark-window-synthetic.describes: The whole window after the Benchmark panel generated one million points of the Model surface pattern: the synthetic point cloud on the canvas and the panel's presets, point count, pattern and embeddings controls in the sidebar; the live readout is omitted.

orientation-phone-sidebar.name: phone-sidebar-open
orientation-phone-sidebar.describes: Cellucid on a phone-sized touch screen with the Pancreas sample open: the sidebar fills the screen, with its close button (✕) in a strip at the top right above the Session section.

orientation-phone-plot.name: phone-plot
orientation-phone-plot.describes: The same phone screen after tapping ✕: the whole Pancreas sample in view on the plot, the menu button (☰) at the top left, and the selection bar with its Select mode switch at the bottom.

loading-gdrive-admin-blocked.name: gdrive-admin-blocked
loading-gdrive-admin-blocked.describes: The Link or server bar after Sign in to Google, for an account whose Google Workspace administrator does not allow Cellucid: the line under it says so and what to do, with a link "How an administrator allows Cellucid" and the button Use another account.
